changelog:
Expanded documentation & a more robust build script

Added

- App configuration guide in SKILL.md — how to set environment variables, encrypted secrets (with secret-slot timing gotchas), and KV/edge storage, including how to read each from Wasm and the "PUT replaces the whole config" caveat.
- requests auto-install manifest declared in frontmatter metadata (required bins, GCORE_API_KEY env, and the uv install step).
- upload and one-shot release commands in scripts/build_rust.py (build → upload → create/update an app in a single step).
- Troubleshooting & common-mistakes table covering Rust toolchain issues, missing .wasm artifacts, auth errors, and raw-string HTML pitfalls.

Fixed

- Build failures from a shadowed Rust toolchain (e.g. Homebrew cargo/rustc ahead of rustup on PATH, missing the wasm32-wasip1 target). The build script now resolves the toolchain via rustup which and respects CARGO/RUSTC overrides.
- More resilient build/deploy error handling and .wasm artifact discovery.

Changed
- requests is now imported lazily, so the build command works without it installed.
summary: Use when building, compiling, or deploying WebAssembly HTTP apps to Gcore FastEdge edge computing — triggers on "deploy to FastEdge", "build a FastEdge app", "Wasm on the edge", "Gcore edge function", uploading a .wasm binary, or working with the fastedge Rust SDK.
